about_the_game:
THIS IS THE FREE DEMO FOR "Every Step Counts" Download it now to experience the Arcade Puzzle Mode! This demo is feature-complete for the core game loop, including the high-stakes Bet system and Leaderboards.

After you've mastered the demo and climbed the leaderboards, be sure to Wishlist the Full Game! The full version will expand these mechanics into a complete role-play adventure game!

Survival of the Smartest.

Forget reflexes. In Every Step Counts Demo, your mind is your greatest weapon. Guide a mathematically challenged serpent through a treacherous grid where every move is calculated – literally! This unique puzzle blends classic snake gameplay with strategic equation-building. Can you crunch the numbers to reach the highest score?

Calculate Your Path to Victory

The serpent awaits your command, unable to calculate its own steps. Each turn, you are presented with a tactical puzzle. Follow the guided steps to build an equation that determines the serpent's fate:

  • Pick Tile: Choose one of three adjacent tiles. This locks in the serpent's direction for the turn and provides the first number for your equation.

  • First Operator: Select your first mathematical operator (+, −, ×, ÷) on the calculator. Earn points instantly based on your choice!

  • Roll Dice: The mischievous God of Fate intervenes! A random number form a dice (1-6) is rolled, becoming the second number in your equation. Adapt your strategy on the fly!

  • Second Operator: Choose your second operator, adding another layer of calculation and scoring potential.

  • Your Input: This is your moment to bend fate. Enter the final number to complete the equation. Use the backspace if you need to reconsider!

  • Calculate! Hit the "=" button. The equation resolves, the final step count is revealed, and the serpent executes the move in the direction you chose at the start. Watch the consequences unfold!

High Stakes, High Rewards: The Bet System

Feeling confident? At the very start of your turn (before picking a tile), you can activate the BET button. This is a high-stakes gamble:

  • WIN: If the serpent successfully eats an apple during that exact turn, your entire current score is DOUBLED!

  • LOSE: If you fail to eat the apple during the bet turn (even if you survive), your score drops to ZERO!

  • Recharge: The Bet ability is precious. After using it, you can only recharge it by eating an apple without a bet active. Choose your moment wisely!

Master the Grid: Rules & Scoring

Success demands careful calculation and strategic planning.

  • Movement: The final result of your equation determines the number of steps the serpent moves in the chosen direction.

  • Scoring:

    • + Operator: +50 Points

    • − Operator: +100 Points

    • × Operator: +250 Points

    • ÷ Operator: +500 Points

    • Eating Food: +1000 Points

    • Successful Move (Positive Result): +10 Points

  • Game Over: Your run ends immediately if:

    • The final calculated result is 0 or negative.

    • The serpent collides with a wall.

    • The serpent collides with its own body.

    • You attempt to divide by zero.

What's Included in This Demo:

This demo features the complete Arcade Mode, designed to let you experience the core strategic gameplay and unique mechanics.

  • The Full Core Gameplay: Experience the complete, endlessly replayable puzzle challenge.

  • The Bet System: Master the high-stakes "Bet" mechanic, where you can double your score or lose it all.

  • Leaderboards: Compete for the #1 spot on the official demo leaderboard!

The Full Game Will Feature:

This demo is just the beginning. By reviewing and wishlisting the full game, you are supporting the development of a Role-Play Adventure Mode that builds on this core mechanic, including:

  • A narrative driven map to explore.

  • New enemies and challenges that turn your calculator into a weapon.

  • Game-Changing Twists.

Thank you for playing this demo. Every piece of feedback helps us build the full adventure. Don't forget to Wishlist the Full Game!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or newer / SteamOS
  • Processor: Dual Core CPU @ 2.0GHz+
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 / Vulkan compatible graphics card with up-to-date drivers (Mesa for AMD/Intel, NVIDIA proprietary)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Requires Steam Client running for Leaderboard functionality. Performance may vary depending on distribution and driver versions.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Modern Linux Distribution / SteamOS (Latest)
  • Processor: Quad Core CPU @ 2.5GHz+
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with robust Vulkan support (AMD GCN+, NVIDIA Kepler+)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Requires Steam Client running for Leaderboard functionality. Performance may vary depending on distribution and driver versions.
